# Tier 2 — Specialized Medications
These medications are strong in healing a specific type of damage.
## Brute
Be warned that if mixed with each other or Bicaridine, these [textlink="specialized brute chemicals" link="AdvancedBrute"] will create Razorium, a reagent that induces severe bleeding on contact or ingestion.
## Burn
The specialized burn chemicals mix freely with other medications. Take note of Pyrazine's slow metabolism rate.
## Toxin
Although Arithrazine is as easy to make as other Tier 1 medicines, it's still as strong and as versatile as other Tier 2 medications.
